title: Remove the QUEST_SOURCE_REF pin from ci.yml and release.yml once quest 0.14.2 is on npm (the LCLI-750 / #646 shape)
description: Clean-up for the 0.14.2 pair release (LCLI-775, ODOC-556). The 0.14.2 bump PR (lore-cli#702) carries a QUEST_SOURCE_REF pin, set to quest-cli's dev squash SHA that carries 0.14.2, in ci.yml and release.yml, with source-ref passed at each setup-quest caller, because quest 0.14.2 is not on npm when lore's checks run (setup-quest source-build fallback, DEC-55). Same shape as 0.14.1's bump (85d583c8, pin 053d8595) and its removal (LCLI-750, #646, 222ecb1b). Once quest 0.14.2 is installable from npm (exact version, or a staged release-candidate carrying that base), delete the pin and the source-ref passes in the same way and keep setup-quest's optional empty source-ref input. Release path and CI workflow: needs the leader's dispatch-floor brief. Do not start before quest 0.14.2 is on npm.
